subject: Request: post-audit continuity endorsement & KMS evidence (VectorWave Health)
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@vectorwave.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@vectorwave.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bridge endorsement / KMS snapshot request (VectorWave)

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — VectorWave is close to completing our security review. Our procurement and infosec teams reviewed Redwood's SOC 2 Type II but have a short gap: the report covers through 2023-06-30 and our go-live date is planned for May 2027. Could you provide a short continuity/bridge endorsement that confirms there have been no material changes to the covered controls since the report end date, and include a snapshot of KMS access for the last rotation cycle?

Specifically we need: 
- A one-page post-audit continuity endorsement/bridge letter (signed) that states controls in scope remain materially unchanged since 2023-06-30.
- KMS access snapshot (CSV) showing current key holders, roles, and last rotation timestamps.
- Optional: a short note about any scoped changes that might affect encryption or key management (if applicable).

Our legal team will need the signed endorsement in DocuSign format if possible. Timeline: procurement is aiming to complete by 4/29 — is that feasible?

Thanks,
Lydia Park
Security & Privacy Lead
VectorWave Health

--
Lydia Park
VectorWave Health
lydia.park@vectorwave.com

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@vectorwave.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bridge endorsement / KMS snapshot request (VectorWave)

Hi Lydia — thanks for the clear ask and for outlining the timeline. We can provide a concise post-audit continuity endorsement and the KMS snapshot. Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):

1) Redwood to prepare:
   - Draft one-page continuity endorsement (PDF) stating there are no material changes to controls in scope since 2023-06-30.
   - Export KMS access snapshot (CSV) showing key IDs, roles with access, and last rotation dates.
   - Attach our SOC 2 Type II (PDF) as a reference copy.
2) VectorWave to review and confirm signatory for DocuSign (procurement or legal).
3) Redwood to send DocuSign powerform link and original files for your records.

We expect to have the draft endorsement and the KMS CSV ready by EOD 4/25; internal security will review and we can send the DocuSign package by 4/26. I’ve looped in Kimberly (security compliance lead) and Rishi (customer security escalation) for approvals.

Questions for you:
- Can procurement confirm the DocuSign signer (name/email) you want on the final endorsement?
- Any additional evidence formats you prefer (e.g., signed attestation vs. short memo)?

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive — Security & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20230101-20230630.pdf (will send with the endorsement)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bridge endorsement / KMS snapshot request (VectorWave)

Mateo / Rishi — quick internal note:

I’ll run the continuity wording past Infosec and Legal today. Key items to confirm before signing:
- No changes to scope (control mapping) for encryption, key lifecycle, or privileged access since 2023-06-30.
- KMS snapshot will be redacted to remove individual email addresses for operators; we can provide roles + hashed identifiers for personnel if VectorWave requires.
- We should include a short paragraph describing our KMS rotation cadence and HSM/KMS provider (region-specific note for compliance).

Target: I’ll get final sign-off from Infosec by COB 4/25 so Mateo can send the DocuSign package on 4/26. If any control changes are found we’ll propose an addendum rather than delaying the endorsement.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Manager

Hi Lydia — quick update and delivery:

Attached: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20230101-20230630.pdf (reference), Redwood_PostAudit_Continuity_Endorsement_20270426.pdf (one-page signed draft), KMS_Access_Snapshot_20270425.csv (redacted per our policy).

DocuSign: We’ve created a PowerForm for the endorsement so your legal team can apply an e-signature without manual routing: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-bridge-endorse

Notes on the evidence:
- The endorsement confirms there were no material changes to the in-scope controls affecting encryption/key management between 2023-06-30 and 2027-04-26.
- KMS CSV includes key IDs, role-level access, and last rotation timestamps. Personal identifiers are redacted; we included role mappings and hashed operator IDs.
- If you require a version with explicit operator IDs for audit, please confirm the contact and authorized purposes and we’ll evaluate a secure transfer (SFTP or customer-specific NDA).

Next steps: please confirm the signer for DocuSign and we’ll finalize the signature page immediately. If VectorWave needs any additional evidence (audit logs, rotation proof, or encryption config snippets), let us know and we’ll scope what can be shared.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — we’ll keep this on priority.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive — Security & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
